messages:
maria: Quick sync — pricing change rollout next Wed. Need final signoff on metering adapter, billing mapping, quota enforcement, and contract constraint behavior. Owners below; call out if anything missing.

sam: I can take metering adapter (eng). Branch ready, waiting on billing mapping schema. cc @jordan-billing

jordan-billing: Working on billing schema v2. Two open items: 1) representation for reserved-capacity discounts, 2) proration on plan switch. Will have PR by EOD Tue. One note: prefer event key `usage.unit` instead of `units` — that'll break current ingesters if we flip it without a compatibility window.

sam: we can accept both keys for a 48h compatibility window behind a feature flag. Plan to push toggle to staging today. Example adapter snippet:
```
if "usage.unit" in event.payload:
  units = event.payload["usage.unit"]
else:
  units = event.payload.get("units", 0)
```

maria: Contract/legal question: quota override behavior — do we allow product teams to temporarily bypass quotas for legacy customers? @tina-legal

tina-legal: Contract team stance: default = no overrides unless there's a signed amendment. For legacy customers we can do temporary quota bypasses via an amendment, but it must be logged and timeboxed. Please add an audit event and a change-note that surfaces in the console.

devops-bot: deploy v2-metering-adapter -> staging succeeded (<https://ci.redwood.example/build/4521|build/4521>) :white_check_mark:

alex-sre: Heads up — quota enforcement relies on the new Redis key schema. If we flip-wide it'll cause a lot of short TTL hits and could spike mem usage. SRE needs a canary rollout per region. Sam, can you add region-level canary flags and a gradual ramp?

sam: yup — will add `canary_region` config and default `0.1` ramp. PR will include toggles for per-region capacity and a fallback that reads old keys if `compat_mode` is enabled.

maria: Updated owner matrix in the RFC doc: metering = sam, billing = jordan-billing, contracts = tina-legal, sres = alex-sre, product = maria. Timeline I propose: PRs by Tue EOD, canary Wed AM, monitor 6h, full rollout Thu PM. Any immediate blockers?

ben: blocker — IAM for billing export to BigQuery (REQ-594) still pending approval from infra. If that slips we can't land the BigQuery export path.

jordan-billing: noted. We should have a fallback to S3 export in the schema. I'll include an S3 export path and credential-check step in the PR. If IAM not approved, we flip to S3 and re-enable BQ later.

maria: Action items recap: Sam -> PR + region canary flags + compat mode; Jordan -> billing schema PR + S3 fallback; Tina -> confirm amendment template and audit spec; Alex -> rollout playbook + mem spike mitigation; Ben -> follow up on REQ-594. I'll sync this into the RFC doc and ping for signoffs. <https://docs.redwood.example/rfcs/pricing-rollout|RFC link> :thumbsup:

sam: ack. pinging @eng-oncall for canary window when ready.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll send a short summary to execs after we have the PRs.
